entries.text: Tile backgrounds use the approved surface tokens. Do not use saturated brand colors for large background areas.
Cap badges use only the approved VDS palette tokens: red, yellow, green, orange, blue, neonYellow, grayHighContrast, grayLowContrast, black, white.
The compact badge size is the standard for plan tiles. Keep badges short, one to three words.
Show a price difference as the new price next to the old price, with the saving stated in a badge.
